subject: Re: POC kickoff / trial access — Helix Health
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff / trial access — Helix Health (post-call recap)

Hi Jordan / Priya — great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get your trial/POC started:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization at 5-10 reqs/sec with sub-200ms p95 for short notes.
- Success criteria: 90% accuracy on our shared eval prompts, infra compatibility with your HIPAA controls.
- Plan: Redwood will provision a 2-week trial environment and a small dedicated slot for a live 2-hour pilot session.

Next steps I can take this week (pending your green light):
1) Provision trial instance + invite service account (I need your technical contact + IP allowlist).
2) Share onboarding checklist and SOW (attached).
3) Schedule kickoff pilot — I proposed Mon 26 or Tue 27; please confirm availability.

Attachments: redwood-trial-onboarding-checklist.pdf, POC_SOW_Helix_Health.pdf

If you can send me the name/email of the person who will handle the IT/security setup, I'll add them to the provisioning ticket and share the IPs and certs they'll need.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes

Hi Jordan / Priya — bumping this one again. We haven't heard back on the IT contact or kickoff window and I want to make sure this is still a priority for your team.

Options to make this easier if timing is tight:
- I can provision the trial with limited access and send a step-by-step guide your IT team can action asynchronously.
- We can push the kickoff and I'll hold the trial slot for 30 days.
- Alternatively, a short 30-minute call with your IT/procurement will usually clear the required sign-offs.

Could you let me know which of the above you'd prefer, or if this should be deferred to next quarter?

Thanks — Rafael

Unfortunately this means we can't kick off the trial this month — it's looking like the earliest we'll re-open is January.

Could you send a one-page checklist I can share with procurement/IT that summarizes the items they'll need from Redwood (SOC 2 link, onboarding steps, IPs, minimal network changes)? If you can also confirm any temporary measures (VPN/SSH tunnel) we can use for the pilot that would be helpful.

- Offer: we'll hold your trial slot and extend the trial window to account for the delay; I can also prepare a short internal deck you can share with procurement.
